## 5. Pre-flight checklist

1. Commit the gate journal via the pre-flight journal-commit step before anything else, so worktrees branch from committed state.
2. Repo state: confirm repo/ is a git repository; if it is not, run `git init` on repo/ and make an initial commit.
   Run the dirty-tree check (`git -C <repo> status --porcelain` must print nothing); if it is dirty, STOP and ask the human.
3. Record the pre-run base: `git -C <repo> rev-parse HEAD`, saved in the gate journal as `<pre-run-base>`.
4. Create the integration branch: `git -C <repo> branch loop/drive-integration <pre-run-base>`.
5. Create the log directory `docs/loop/logs/` and the handoffs directory `docs/handoffs/` on the integration branch if they do not exist (handoffs-home defaults to docs/handoffs/ because docs/loop/pointer.md does not exist).
6. Probe results, with disclose lines quoted verbatim:

   Ringer probe: `[ -f "${RINGER_ROOT:-$HOME/repos/ringer}/ringer.py" ]` with RINGER_ROOT=/nonexistent/ringer-is-not-installed-here gave ABSENT.
   Degraded mode.

ringer not found at the probed path; running degraded: background-agent transport only, routing by prior.

herdr not detected; dispatching workers through the harness's own background-agent transport.

   CEZ_TASK_ID is unset, so the cezar transport is not in play and no cezar disclose line applies.

7. Compile-time note: the shell sandbox failed to initialize during compile.
   The probe commands, the `git init` of repo/, and the dirty-tree check could not be executed at compile time.
   Probe results above are by path inspection; the RINGER_ROOT path is a declared nonexistent path.
   All of these must be re-run at launch, as a dry run, before wave 1.

Ringer is absent, so the routing skips the scoreboard tier entirely.
- Ringer: ABSENT. Probe: `[ -f "${RINGER_ROOT:-$HOME/repos/ringer}/ringer.py" ]`.
Skip `ringer.py lint` because ringer is absent.
